subpages.meta_description: Marc Zurlinden and twenty years of air-cooled 911s, now at our shop in Atlantic Beach, Florida.
subpages.text_content: About | Zurlinden Gruppe | Black Friday 10% off all ZG‑ACF parts · 20% off two or more · Free domestic shipping · Through November 30 Up to 20% off ZG‑ACF parts See the parts | 911 SP | Builds & Restorations | Services & Parts | Partners | ZG-ACF | For sale | About | Contact | About | An uncompromising commitment | In a family garage on the Monterey Peninsula, Marc Zurlinden turned wrenches on his father's weekend racers. He went on to become an automation engineer and innovator, and turned to 911 restorations in the great Californian tradition. He has since worked with clients across the country and around the world. | While I didn't know it at the time, my love for Porsche began when I went with my father to buy a used 1972 911T from an Army sergeant. The car was twelve and I was ten. Always eager for a ride, I'd look for passing opportunities just to hear the engine wail at full throttle. Since then I've done everything I can to get closer to these thrilling cars. | For me, the best thing about a 911 is its range across the whole spectrum of sports car driving. I'd love to own one of every kind and drive each for its occasion. But the greatest reward is taking part in its legacy: providing the knowledge, service and parts that let owners experience the very best of their cars today. | Marc Zurlinden | For twenty years we've honored Porsche engineering while bringing in new ideas. As Zuffenhausen built 911s for everything from endurance racing to the Safari, we build our own thoughtful interpretations of the 911.
